verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is AI accelerator hardware with a training and inference software stack. Bulk operations across many items, meaning batch actions on records or objects in an app or service, are not an axis this kind of product competes on. Nothing in the evidence shows such a capability: batch-size mentions concern inference throughput, which is a different concept.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
